name: 🌀 Scrape Telegram & Save Archive

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *'
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [telegram-news-hourly, telegram-news-scrape]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      channel_name:
        description: 'Channel username (without @). Empty = all from State list'
        required: false
        default: ''
      add_only_channels:
        description: 'Only add these channels to list (comma-separated). No scrape.'
        required: false
        default: ''
      run_like_hourly:
        description: 'true = same as hourly (50 posts, multi-channel)'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
      max_posts:
        description: 'Max posts (empty = auto)'
        required: false
        default: ''
      stop_before_post_id:
        description: 'Stop before this post id'
        required: false
        default: ''
      debug_mode:
        description: 'true = text-only debug scraper'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
      save_to:
        description: 'repository or artifact'
        required: false
        default: 'repository'

# NOTE: remainder of workflow is in scrape_part1/2 — assembled by fix-scrape-yml
# This is a staging file only.
PLACEHOLDER_PART0_SEE_ASSEMBLY
